annotations.title: Load a preset through a relay

description: Load a shared preset (find_presets, get_preset) into the user's device through a relay: its settings are sent through the driver, its patch data as SysEx — which replaces the sound the device holds, so the relay asks the user to accept it and this call waits for the answer (up to 2 minutes): tell the user first. Afterwards, tell SynthHub how it went with report_preset.

code.description: The pairing code the relay page or program shows.

device.description: The device it goes into, when not the preset's own: one of get_preset's loads_on (an M-VAVE FM-1 takes DX7 voices); the sound is sent unchanged.

gap_ms.description: Pause between the SysEx messages, for devices that write slowly (default 50).

port.description: Output port name (or part of it); needed when the relay has several.

user_id.description: Your anonymous SynthHub id, if you kept it from an earlier session (see the server instructions). Optional.

name: load_preset
